This page describes "turning" as a change in personality and voluntary swearing to the dark one rather than an involuntary submittal to the influence of the Shadow.  Is this view documented anywhere?  I think it is a wrong interpretation.  Nothing I recall indicates that the people turned voluntarily commit to the shadow.[[User:Allianna4|Allianna4]] ([[User talk:Allianna4|talk]]) 16:44, November 9, 2012 (UTC)
:I don't think it's using 'choose' in that way - just that AFTER the personality corruption, they find it perfectly acceptable/rational to swear to the Shadow.
